annotations.title: Find the Vigi-Sky page to cite

description: Map a user question to the single best Vigi-Sky page (or the official GEIPAN page for French UFO reports) to cite as a source, with alternatives. Use it when you need a URL to back an answer; it does not answer the question itself, so call the matching tool (aurora, iss_city_passes, what_did_i_see...) for live data. Keyword match over a fixed page catalogue, no network call.

lang.description: Language of the text fields: fr (default) or en.

query.description: The user's question or topic, in French or English, e.g. 'aurore boréale en France'.

name: cite

outputSchema.description: Returns best {url, title}, alternatives [...], citations, provenance.
